## Fig. 1H 
```{r}
se <- readRDS("objects/CRS2025_polyA_salmon.SE.analysed.rds")
ctrl_genes <- readRDS("objects/CRS2025_Cycling_genes.rds")

metadata(se)$anno_colors <- list(
  Group = c(
    "morning.Ctrl" = "#D1DEC8",
    "evening.Ctrl" = "#7D9970",
    "morning.CRS"  = "#E3CDB8",
    "evening.CRS"  = "#BC7A5C"))

hmcols <- c("#5D7290","#FAF7F2","#7A6A60")

setSechmOption("hmcols",value = hmcols)

group_order <- factor(
  paste(
    colData(se)$Period,
    colData(se)$Condition,
    sep = "."
  ),
  levels = c(
    "morning.Ctrl",
    "evening.Ctrl",
    "morning.CRS",
    "evening.CRS"))

hm <- sechm(
  se,
  features = ctrl_genes,
  assayName = "scaledLFC",
  do.scale = FALSE,
  gaps_at = c("Condition"),
  column_order = colnames(se)[order(group_order)],
  top_annotation = "Group",
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  name = "RNA (scaled)")

svg("plots/Fig1/RNA_Hippocampus.svg", width = 7.5, height = 6)
draw(hm)
```


## Fig. 1I
```{r}
amp_df <- readRDS("objects/RNA_amplifications.rds")
fc_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    logFC = amp_df$CTRL_logFC,
    Group = "Control"),
  data.frame(
    logFC = amp_df$CRS_logFC,
    Group = "Stress"))

density_plot <- ggplot(fc_long,
  aes(
    x = logFC,
    colour = Group,
    fill = Group)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 2.5) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 2 ) +
  annotate("label",x = Inf,y = Inf,
  label = paste0(
    "Wilcoxon-Pratt\n",
    "Z = 35.09\n",
    "p < 1e-4"), hjust = 1.05,vjust = 1.1,size = 6, label.size = 0.8, fill = "white",color = "black", fontface = "bold", lineheight = 1.1)+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.5, 0.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Control = "#7D9970",Stress = "#D0A489")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Control = "#7D9970", Stress = "#D0A489")) +
  labs(x = "logFC (morning - evening)", y = "Density") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 25) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 35,face = "bold"), 
    axis.text = element_text(size = 25, colour = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 2),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 2),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.35, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 25))

density_plot
ggsave("plots/Fig1/RNA_hippocampuslogFC_density.svg",density_plot, width = 8, height = 6)

```

# Fig. 2
## Fig. 2A
```{r}
oxi_genebody <- readRDS("objects/hippocampus_oxoG_genebody_combined_analysed.rds")

J_palette <- c("Ctrl_morning" = "#D1DEC8","Ctrl_evening" = "#7D9970")

metadata(oxi_genebody)$anno_colors <- list(group = J_palette)

tmp <- rowData(oxi_genebody)
tmp_all <- tmp[order(tmp$FDR_all), ]

sigGenes_genebody_all_AMvsPM <- rownames(tmp_all)[
  which(!duplicated(tmp_all$gene_symbol) & tmp_all$DEA.all.Morning_vs_Evening$FDR < 0.05)]

oxi_genebody_for_heatmap <- oxi_genebody
# keep only controls
oxi_genebody_for_heatmap <- oxi_genebody_for_heatmap[,oxi_genebody_for_heatmap$group %in% c("Ctrl_morning","Ctrl_evening")]

# Remove Ensembl version numbers
rownames(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap) <- sub("\\..*", "", rownames(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap))

# Create mapping ENSG -> gene symbol
gene_labels <- rowData(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap)$gene_symbol
names(gene_labels) <- rownames(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap)

# Replace rownames by gene symbols
new_names <- gene_labels
new_names[is.na(new_names) |new_names == ""] <- rownames(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap)[
    is.na(new_names) | new_names == ""]

rownames(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap) <- make.unique(new_names)
colnames(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap) <- as.character(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap$group)

features_all_AMvsPM_clean <- sub("\\..*", "",sigGenes_genebody_all_AMvsPM)
features_all_AMvsPM_symbols <-gene_labels[features_all_AMvsPM_clean]
features_all_AMvsPM_symbols <- features_all_AMvsPM_symbols[!is.na(features_all_AMvsPM_symbols)]

hmcols <- c("#5D7290","#FAF7F2","#7A6A60")
ht_opt(simple_anno_size = unit(20, "mm"))

svg("plots/Fig2/Genebody_oxoG_Ctrl_AMvsPM.svg",width = 7.5,height = 6)

mat <- assay(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap, "oxoG_all_level")
mat <- t(scale(t(mat)))
mat[mat > 1.5] <- 1.5
mat[mat < -1.5] <- -1.5
assay(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap, "oxoG_scaled") <- mat

p <- draw(
  sechm(
    oxi_genebody_for_heatmap,
    features_all_AMvsPM_symbols,
    assayName = "oxoG_scaled",
    hmcols = hmcols,
    do.scale = FALSE,
    top_annotation = "group",
    show_rownames = FALSE,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    column_title = "Gene body oxoG (AM vs PM)",
    name = "oxoG level (scaled)"),
  show_annotation_legend = FALSE)
ht_opt(simple_anno_size = unit(5, "mm"))
p
```

## Fig. 2B

```{r}
summary_df <- readRDS("objects/hippocampus_oxoG_quantile_transcribed.rds")
summary_df <- summary_df %>% filter(Treatment %in% c("Ctrl_morning", "Ctrl_evening"))

p <- ggplot(
    summary_df,
    aes(
      x = Group,
      y = mean_val,
      color = Treatment,
      linetype = Treatment,
      shape = Treatment,
      group = Treatment)) +
    geom_point(size = 8) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2), color = "black")+
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val),
      width = 0.15,
      linewidth = 1.8,
      linetype = "solid") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(Ctrl_morning = "#D1DEC8",Ctrl_evening = "#7D9970"),
      name = "") +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(Ctrl_morning = 16, Ctrl_evening = 16),name = "") +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(Ctrl_morning = "solid",Ctrl_evening = "solid"),name = "") +
    labs(
      x = "Gene expression tiers",
      y = "Guanine oxidation (arb. unit)",
      title = "DNA oxidation and global transcription",
      subtitle = "Transcribed strand") +
    theme_classic() +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.85, 1.9)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0.85, 1.9, by = 0.25)) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 35, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 35, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 25),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 25),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 35),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.8),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1.8),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.35, "cm"))
p
ggsave("plots/Fig2/hippocampus_transcribed_strand_expr.svg", p, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 600, units = "in")
```

## Fig. 2D

```{r}
final_results_expressed <- readRDS("objects/hippocampus_oxoG_around_TSS_CTRL_results.rds")
summary_df_allgene_expressed <- final_results_expressed$summary
brks <- seq(0, 200, by = 25)
labs <- rep("", length(brks))
sel <- brks %in% c(0, 100, 200)
labs[sel] <- c("-20Kb", "TSS", "+20Kb")

condition_sep <- summary_df_allgene_expressed %>%
  group_by(group, counter, strand) %>%
  summarise(oxoG = mean(mean_val, na.rm = TRUE), se = mean(se_val, na.rm = TRUE),.groups = "drop")

p_combined <- ggplot(
  condition_sep,
  aes(x = counter,y = oxoG,
    colour = group,
    fill = group,
    linetype = strand,
    group = interaction(group, strand))) +
    #geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2), linewidth = 2.0) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = oxoG - se, ymax = oxoG + se), alpha = 0.1, color = NA,position = position_dodge(width = 0.2))+
scale_color_manual(values = c("Ctrl_morning" = "#D1DEC8","Ctrl_evening" = "#7D9970"),
  name = "Group") +
scale_fill_manual(values = c("Ctrl_morning" = "#D1DEC8","Ctrl_evening" = "#7D9970"),
  name = "Group") +
scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Transcribed" = "solid","Non-transcribed" = "22"),
  name = "Strand")  +
  ylim(c(0.4,1.8))+
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 210),
    breaks = brks,
    labels = labs,
    expand = c(0, 0)) +
  annotate("text", x = 35, y = 0.45, label = "bins=200b", hjust = 0.5, size = 10) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")+
    labs(x = "", y = "Guanine oxidation (arb. unit)", title = "Guanine oxidation around TSS")+
   theme_classic()+theme(
    axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 35, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y  = element_text(size = 35, face = "bold"),
    title  = element_text(size =40),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.line     = element_line(size = 1.8),
    axis.ticks    = element_line(size = 1.8),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.35, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "lines"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.position = c(0.95, 0.05),legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"))
p_combined
ggsave("plots/Fig2/hippocampus_oxoG_around_TSS.svg", p_combined, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 600, units = "in")
```

## Fig. 2F
```{r}
dinuc <- readRDS("objects/hippocampus_dinuc_summary_satellite.rds")
dinuc_long <- dinuc  %>% pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ApG, TpG, CpG, GpG), names_to = "dinucleotide", values_to = "oxoG_level")

# Keep only control samples
dinuc_summary_ctrl <- dinuc_long %>% dplyr::filter(
    Treatment %in% c("Ctrl_morning","Ctrl_evening")) %>%
  group_by(dinucleotide, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(oxoG_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(oxoG_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n()),.groups = "drop")

# Order dinucleotides
dinuc_summary_ctrl$dinucleotide <- factor(dinuc_summary_ctrl$dinucleotide, levels = c("ApG", "TpG", "CpG", "GpG"))

# Plot
p_dinuc_ctrl <- ggplot(
  dinuc_summary_ctrl,
  aes(
    x = dinucleotide,
    y = mean,
    color = Treatment,
    group = Treatment)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(
      ymin = mean - se,
      ymax = mean + se),
    width = 0.05,
    linewidth = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2.5, color = "black") +
  geom_point(size = 15) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Ctrl_morning" = "#D1DEC8",
      "Ctrl_evening" = "#7D9970")) +
  labs(
    x = "Dinucleotides with oxidized G at 2nd pos",
    y = expression("Guanine oxidation (arb. unit)"))  +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 35, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 35, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 25,color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 25,color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.8),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1.8),
    legend.position = "none") +

scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,4), breaks = seq(0,4, by = 1))
p_dinuc_ctrl
ggsave("plots/Fig2/hippocampus_dinuc_analysis_satellite.svg", p_dinuc_ctrl, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 600, units = "in")
```

## Fig. 2H
```{r}
meth_agg <- readRDS("objects/hipppocampus_oxoG_methylation.rds")
df <- as.data.frame(
  cbind(
    methyl_label = rowData(meth_agg)[,"methyl_label"],
    oxoG = rowData(meth_agg)[,"oxoG_counts"]
  )
)

df_long <- df %>% pivot_longer(
  cols = c(-methyl_label),
  values_to = "oxoG",
  names_to = "sample")
df_long$sample <- sub("^oxoG\\.", "", df_long$sample)
mean_across_sites <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(methyl_label, sample) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_val = mean(as.numeric(oxoG), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
mean_across_sites$condition <- sub("^[0-9]+_", "", mean_across_sites$sample)

mean_across_sites_ctrl <- mean_across_sites %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("^Ctrl", condition))

summary_df <- mean_across_sites_ctrl %>%
  dplyr::group_by(methyl_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_oxoG = mean(mean_val, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_val = sd(mean_val, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_df$methyl_label <- factor(
  summary_df$methyl_label,
  levels = c("No", "Medium", "High"))
mean_across_sites_ctrl$methyl_label <- factor(
  mean_across_sites_ctrl$methyl_label,
  levels = c("No", "Medium", "High"))

p_plot <- ggplot(
  summary_df,
  aes(
    x = methyl_label,
    y = mean_oxoG,
    color = methyl_label)) +
  geom_point(size = 15) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_oxoG - se_val,
      ymax = mean_oxoG + se_val),
    width = 0.35,
    linewidth = 2.0) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
  "No"     = "#D9D9D9",
  "Medium" = "#8CBFD6",
  "High"   = "#3F6F8C"
)) +
  labs(
    x = "CpG methylation level",
    y = "Guanine oxidation level (arb. unit)",
    color = "Methylation") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 35, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 35, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 35),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 33),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 2),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 2),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.35, "cm"))
p_plot
ggsave("plots/Fig2/hippocampus_oxoG_methylation.svg", p_plot, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 600, units = "in")
```

```{r}
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -methyl_label,
    values_to = "oxoG",
    names_to = "sample")

df_long$sample <- sub("^oxoG\\.", "", df_long$sample)

mean_across_sites <- df_long %>%
  group_by(methyl_label, sample) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_val = mean(oxoG, na.rm = TRUE),.groups = "drop")

mean_across_sites$condition <- sub("^[0-9]+_","",mean_across_sites$sample)

mean_across_sites_WT <- mean_across_sites %>% dplyr::filter(sample %in% c("DE02", "DE03", "DE04"))

summary_df <- mean_across_sites_WT %>%
  group_by(methyl_label) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_oxoG = mean(mean_val, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_val = sd(mean_val, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

summary_df$methyl_label <- factor(summary_df$methyl_label,levels = c("No", "Medium", "High"))

mean_across_sites_WT$methyl_label <- factor(mean_across_sites_WT$methyl_label, levels = c("No", "Medium", "High"))

p_plot <- ggplot(
  summary_df,
  aes(
    x = methyl_label,
    y = mean_oxoG,
    color = methyl_label)) +
  geom_point(size = 15) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_oxoG - se_val,
      ymax = mean_oxoG + se_val),
    width = 0.35,
    linewidth = 2.0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
  "No"     = "#D9D9D9",
  "Medium" = "#8CBFD6",
  "High"   = "#3F6F8C"
)) +
  labs(
    x = "CpG methylation level",
    y = "Guanine oxidation level (arb. unit)",
    color = "Methylation") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 35, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 35, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 35),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 33),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 2),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 2),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.35, "cm"))
p_plot
ggsave("plots/Fig2/embryo_oxoG_methylation.svg", p_plot, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 600, units = "in")
```

```{r}
## Prepare object for heatmap
oxi_promoter_for_heatmap <- oxi_promoter

## Remove Ensembl version numbers

## Replace rownames with gene symbols
gene_symbols <- rowData(oxi_promoter_for_heatmap)$gene_symbol

rownames(oxi_promoter_for_heatmap) <- make.unique(ifelse(is.na(gene_symbols) | gene_symbols == "", rownames(oxi_promoter_for_heatmap), gene_symbols))

colnames(oxi_promoter_for_heatmap) <- as.character(oxi_promoter_for_heatmap$group)

## Select all AM vs PM significant genes
features_trans_AMvsPM_symbols <- unique(rowData(oxi_promoter)$gene_symbol[rowData(oxi_promoter)$DEA.trans.Morning_vs_Evening$FDR < 0.05])

    name = "oxoG level (scaled)"))

dev.off()
ht_opt(simple_anno_size = unit(5, "mm"))
```

## Fig. 3D
```{r}
genes <- readRDS("objects/CRS2025_CTRL_Cycling_genes.rds")
se <- readRDS("objects/CRS2025_polyA_salmon.SE.analysed.rds")
oxi_promoter <- readRDS("objects/hippocampus_oxoG_promoter.rds")
heatmap_genes <- intersect(genes,rownames(oxi_promoter))
heatmap_genes <- intersect(heatmap_genes,rownames(se))

J_palette <- c(
  "Ctrl_morning" = "#D1DEC8",
  "Ctrl_evening" = "#7D9970",
  "CRS_morning"  = "#E3CDB8",
  "CRS_evening"  = "#BC7A5C")

oxi_promoter$condition <- factor(oxi_promoter$condition,levels = c("Ctrl", "CRS"))
oxi_promoter$period <- factor(oxi_promoter$period,levels = c("morning", "evening"))
oxi_promoter$Group <- paste(oxi_promoter$condition,oxi_promoter$period,sep = "_")
metadata(oxi_promoter)$anno_colors <- list(Group = J_palette)
ord_oxo <- order(oxi_promoter$condition, oxi_promoter$period)
oxi_promoter <- oxi_promoter[, ord_oxo]
se$Condition <- factor(se$Condition,levels = c("Ctrl", "CRS"))
se$Period <- factor(se$Period,levels = c("morning", "evening"))
se$Group <- paste(se$Condition,se$Period,sep = "_")
metadata(se)$anno_colors <- list(Group = J_palette)
ord_rna <- order(se$Condition, se$Period)
se <- se[, ord_rna]
rownames(oxi_promoter) <- sub(".*\\.", "", rownames(oxi_promoter))
rownames(se) <- sub(".*\\.", "", rownames(se))
heatmap_genes_symbols <- sub(".*\\.", "", heatmap_genes)
rna_mat <- assay(se, "log2FC")[heatmap_genes_symbols, ]
cor_mat <- cor(t(rna_mat),method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
ord <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor(t(rna_mat))), method = "average")$order
genes_ord <- rownames(rna_mat)[ord]
hmcols <- c("#5D7290", "#FAF7F2", "#7A6A60")

## Heatmap
svg("plots/Fig3/Promoter_oxoG_RNA_sig_oxoG.svg", width = 7.5, height = 6)

draw(
  sechm(
    oxi_promoter,
    genes_ord,
    assayName = "oxoG_trans_level",
    do.scale = TRUE,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    hmcols = hmcols,
    top_annotation = "Group",
    column_title = "Promoter oxoG transcribed strand",
    name = "oxoG level (scaled)") +

  sechm(
    se,
    genes_ord,
    assayName = "scaledLFC",
    do.scale = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    hmcols = hmcols,
    top_annotation = "Group",
    show_rownames = FALSE,
    column_title = "RNA (scaledLFC)",
    name = "scaledLFC"),
  merge_legend = FALSE,
  gap = unit(2, "mm"))

dev.off()
```

## Suppl. Fig. 3C
```{r}
genes <- readRDS("objects/CRS2025_CTRL_Cycling_genes.rds")
RNA <- readRDS("objects/CRS2025_polyA_salmon.SE.analysed.rds")
oxoG_promoter <- readRDS("objects/hippocampus_oxoG_promoter.rds")
RNA$group <- paste0(RNA$Condition,"_",RNA$Period)
oxoG_promoter$group <- paste0( oxoG_promoter$condition,"_",oxoG_promoter$period)
rownames(RNA) <- sub("^([^.]+)\\.(.+)$","\\2.\\1",rownames(RNA))

parts <- strsplit(rownames(RNA), "\\.")

rownames(RNA) <- sapply(parts,
  function(x)
    paste(x[2], x[1], sep = "."))

heatmap_genes <- intersect(genes,rownames(oxoG_promoter))

heatmap_genes <- intersect(heatmap_genes,rownames(RNA))

oxoG_mean <- rowMeans(assay(oxoG_promoter,"oxoG_trans_level")[heatmap_genes, ])

RNA_mean <- rowMeans(assay(RNA,"TPM")[heatmap_genes, ])

promoter_df <- data.frame(
  gene = heatmap_genes,
  oxoG = oxoG_mean,
  TPM = RNA_mean)

promoter_df <- na.omit(promoter_df)
promoter_df$log_oxoG <- log10(promoter_df$oxoG + 1)
promoter_df$log_TPM <- log10(promoter_df$TPM + 1)

cor_res <- cor.test(promoter_df$log_oxoG, promoter_df$log_TPM, method = "spearman")

cor_res

p_corr <- ggplot(promoter_df,
  aes(
    x = log_oxoG,
    y = log_TPM)) +
  ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity(size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 1.2,
    size = 6,
    label = paste0(
      "Spearman rho = ",
      round(cor_res$estimate, 3),
      "\nP = ",
      signif(cor_res$p.value, 3))) +
  labs(
    x = expression(log[10]~"(Promoter oxoG)"),
    y = expression(log[10]~"(TPM)")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 22)
```

## Suppl. Fig. 3D
```{r}
oxi_promoter <- readRDS("objects/hippocampus_oxoG_promoter_analysed.rds")
se <- readRDS("objects/CRS2025_polyA_salmon.SE.analysed.rds")

# Significant promoter oxoG AM vs PM genes

tmp <- rowData(oxi_promoter)
tmp_trans <- tmp[order(tmp$DEA.trans.Morning_vs_Evening$FDR),]

sigGenes <- rownames(tmp_trans)[
  !duplicated(tmp_trans$gene_symbol) & tmp_trans$DEA.trans.Morning_vs_Evening$FDR < 0.05]

# Match IDs across datasets
sigGenes_clean <- sub("\\..*","",sigGenes)
oxo_ids <- sub("\\..*","", rownames(oxi_promoter))
rna_ids <- sub("\\..*","",rownames(se))
common_ids <- Reduce(intersect, list(sigGenes_clean, oxo_ids, rna_ids))
oxo_idx <- match(common_ids, oxo_ids)
rna_idx <- match(common_ids,rna_ids)
oxo_rows <- rownames(oxi_promoter)[oxo_idx]
rna_rows <- rownames(se)[rna_idx]

# Cluster genes using RNA profiles

rna_mat <- assay(se,"corrected")[rna_rows, ]
keep <- rowSums(abs(rna_mat)) > 0
rna_mat <- rna_mat[keep, ]
rna_rows <- rna_rows[keep]
oxo_rows <- oxo_rows[keep]
ord <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor(t(rna_mat), method = "pearson")),method = "average")$order

rna_rows <- rna_rows[ord]
oxo_rows <- oxo_rows[ord]

# Order samples
oxi_promoter$condition <- factor(oxi_promoter$condition,levels = c("Ctrl","CRS"))

oxi_promoter$period <- factor(oxi_promoter$period, levels = c("morning","evening"))

ord_oxo <- order(oxi_promoter$condition, oxi_promoter$period)

oxi_promoter <- oxi_promoter[,ord_oxo]

se$Condition <- factor(se$Condition,levels = c("Ctrl","CRS"))

se$Period <- factor(se$Period,levels = c("morning","evening"))

ord_rna <- order(se$Condition,se$Period)

se <- se[,ord_rna]

metadata(oxi_promoter)$anno_colors <- list(group = c(
    "Ctrl_morning" = "#D1DEC8",
    "Ctrl_evening" = "#7D9970",
    "CRS_morning" = "#E3CDB8",
    "CRS_evening" = "#BC7A5C"))

metadata(se)$anno_colors <- list(Group = c(
    "morning.Ctrl" = "#D1DEC8",
    "evening.Ctrl" = "#7D9970",
    "morning.CRS" = "#E3CDB8",
    "evening.CRS" = "#BC7A5C"))

hmcols <- c("#5D7290", "#FAF7F2", "#7A6A60")

#Plot

svg("plots/Supplementary/Promoter_oxoG_RNA_AMvsPM.svg",width = 7.5,height = 6)

p <- draw(
  sechm(
    oxi_promoter,
    oxo_rows,
    assayName = "oxoG_trans_level",
    do.scale = TRUE,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    hmcols = hmcols,
    top_annotation = "group",
    column_title =
      "Promoter oxoG Transcribed Strand",
    name = "oxoG level (scaled)") +
  sechm(
    se,
    rna_rows,
    assayName = "scaledLFC",
    do.scale = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    hmcols = hmcols,
    top_annotation = "Group",
    show_rownames = FALSE,
```

# Functions

## 2D Embedding
```{r}
plot2D<- function(us, reports = NULL, transitionmatrices = NULL, transitionmatrices_stabilized = NULL, normalize = TRUE, method = "umap", colorby = NULL, colors = NULL, plot.density = FALSE, plot.sem = FALSE, seed = 123, ...){
  require(M3C)
  require(imputeTS)
  if(is.null(reports) & is.null(transitionmatrices) & is.null(transitionmatrices_stabilized)){
    print("neiter reports nor transitionmatrices specified. using all data for 2D embedding")
    if(us$has.updated.analysis$Report){
      reports <- names(us$Report)
    }
    if(us$has.updated.analysis$Transmat){
      transitionmatrices <- us$transitionmatrix_names
    }
  }
  
  #checks if data indicated to be added to the embedding data actually exists, otherwise a warning for each dicrepancy will be produced and the function returns NULL
  check <- FALSE
  if(sum(!reports %in% names(us$Report))){
    warning("selected report(s) for embedding that is not present in US_data:\n", paste(reports[!reports %in% names(us$Report)]))
    check <- TRUE
  }
  if(sum(!transitionmatrices %in% us$transitionmatrix_names)){
    warning("selected transitionmatrix for embedding that is not present in US_data:\n", paste(transitionmatrices[!transitionmatrices %in% us$transitionmatrix_names]))
    check <- TRUE
  }
  for(i in us$file_names){
    if(sum(!transitionmatrices_stabilized %in% names(us$files[[i]]$transmatrix_stabilized))){
      warning(paste("selected stabilized transitionmatrix embedding that is not present in US_data of file:", i), "\n",
              paste(transitionmatrices_stabilized[!transitionmatrices_stabilized %in% names(us$files[[i]]$transmatrix_stabilized)], collapse = "\n"))
      check <- TRUE
    }
  }
  if(check){
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Build up data to be used for 2D Embedding by flattening all selected reports, transitionmatrices and normalized transitionmatices and building up a matrix with samples as rows and features as columns
  mat <- data.frame()
  if(!is.null(reports)){
    print(paste("including report:", reports, sep = " "))
    for(r in reports){
      mat <- rbind(mat,t(us$Report[[r]]))
    }
  }
  if(!is.null(transitionmatrices)){
    print(paste("including transitionmatrix:", transitionmatrices, sep = " "))
    tmat <- list()
    for(i in names(us$files)){
      rdat <- NULL
      for(r in transitionmatrices){
        rdat <- append(rdat,c(us$files[[i]]$transmatrix[[r]]))
      }
      tmat[[i]] <- rdat
    }
    tmat <- do.call(cbind,tmat)
    mat <- rbind(mat,tmat)
  }
  if(!is.null(transitionmatrices_stabilized)){
    print(paste("including stabilized transitionmatrix:", transitionmatrices_stabilized, sep = " "))
    tmat <- list()
    for(i in names(us$files)){
      rdat <- NULL
      for(r in transitionmatrices_stabilized){
        rdat <- append(rdat,c(us$files[[i]]$transmatrix_stabilized[[r]]))
      }
      tmat[[i]] <- rdat
    }
    tmat <- do.call(cbind,tmat)
    mat <- rbind(mat,tmat)
  }
  
  # fill NA and Normalize data
  mat <- as.matrix(imputeTS::na_replace(mat,fill = 0))
  if(normalize){
    mat <- t(apply(mat,MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){if(sum(x) > 0){(x - mean(x)) / (sd(x))}else{x}})) 
  }
  
  # Embedding
  if(method == "umap"){
    res <- M3C::umap(mat, seed = seed, ...)
  }else if(method == "tsne"){
    res <- M3C::tsne(mat, seed = seed, ...)
  }
  
  # Build up final plot
  if(!is.null(colorby)){
    res$data <- cbind(res$data,col = us$meta[,colorby])
    res$data$sz <- 1
    res$data$sz[is.na(res$data$col)] <- 0
    p1 <- ggplot(data.frame(res$data),aes(X1,X2, color = col)) + 
      geom_point(size = (4),alpha = (3.5 + 3.5*res$data$sz)) 
    if(plot.density){
      p1 <- p1 + geom_density2d()
    }
    if(plot.sem){
      aggdat <- aggregate(res$data[,1:2], FUN = mean, by = list(res$data$col))
      aggdat_sem <- aggregate(res$data[,1:2], FUN = function(x){sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))}, by = list(res$data$col))
      aggdat <- cbind(aggdat,X1.sem = aggdat_sem$X1,X2.sem = aggdat_sem$X2)
      
      semdim <- mean(c(aggdat_sem$X1, aggdat_sem$X2))
      p1 <- p1 + geom_errorbar(data = aggdat,aes(ymin = X2 - X2.sem,ymax =  X2 + X2.sem, col = Group.1), width = semdim) + 
        geom_errorbarh(data = aggdat,aes(xmin = X1 - X1.sem,xmax = X1 + X1.sem, col = Group.1), height = semdim)
    }
    if(!is.null(colors)){
      p1 <- p1 + scale_color_manual(values = colors)
    }
  }else{
    p1 <- ggplot(data.frame(res$data),aes(X1,X2)) +
      geom_point()
  }

  p1 <- p1 +
    theme_classic(base_size = 25) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 25)
    )

  return(p1)
}
```

## Histogram Transition Stats
```{r}
PlotTransitionsStats <- function(
    us,
    analysis = NULL,
    labels = NULL,
    title = NULL
){
  require(ggplot2)
  require(cowplot)
  if(is.null(analysis)){
    analysis <- names(us$Results)
  }
  if(is.null(labels)){
    for(i in analysis){
      labels <- unique(
        c(labels, names(us$Results[[i]]$TransitionStats)
        )
      )
    }
  }

  ps <- list()

  for(i in analysis){

    for(j in labels[
      labels %in%
      names(us$Results[[i]]$TransitionStats)
    ]){

      bdat <- data.frame(
        distance =
          us$Results[[i]]$TransitionStats[[j]]$bootstraps
      )

      dis <- us$Results[[i]]$TransitionStats[[j]]$distance
      sigma <- us$Results[[i]]$TransitionStats[[j]]$sigma
      percentile <- us$Results[[i]]$TransitionStats[[j]]$percentile

      p1 <- ggplot(
        bdat,
        aes(distance)
      ) +

        geom_histogram(
          color = "black",
          fill = "lightgrey",
          bins = 30,
          linewidth = 0.8
        ) +

        geom_vline(
          xintercept = dis,
          color = "brown",
          linewidth = 3.2
        ) +

        ylab("Frequency") +
        xlab("Manhattan Distance") +
        ggtitle(title) +

        annotate(
          "label",
          x = Inf,
          y = Inf,
          label = paste0(
            "percentile: ",
            signif(percentile, 4),
            "\n",
            "sigma: ",
            round(sigma, 2),
            "\n",
            "p.value: ",
            signif(
              (
                1 -
                pracma::erf(
                  sigma / sqrt(2)
                )
              ) / 2,
              3
            )
          ),
          hjust = 1.05,
          vjust = 1.1,
          size = 6,
          label.size = 0.8,
          fill = "white",
          color = "black",
          family = "Helvetica",
          lineheight = 1.1
        ) +

        theme_classic(
          base_size = 20
        ) +

        theme(
          plot.title =
            element_text(
              size = 26,
              face = "bold"
            ),
          axis.title =
            element_text(
              size = 28,
              face = "bold"
            ),
          axis.text =
            element_text(
              size = 25
            ),
          axis.line =
            element_line(
              linewidth = 1.5
            ),
          axis.ticks =
            element_line(
              linewidth = 1
            )
        )

      ps[[paste(i, j, sep = "-")]] <-
        cowplot::plot_grid(
          p1,
          nrow = 1,
          rel_widths = c(1)
        )
    }
  }

  cowplot::plot_grid(
    plotlist = ps,
    ncol = 1
  )
}
```



```{r}
library(sechm)
library(ComplexHeatmap)

## Load data
oxi_genebody <- readRDS("objects/hippocampus_oxoG_genebody_analysed.rds")
oxi_genebody <- oxi_genebody[, order(oxi_genebody$group)]

## Colors
J_palette <- c(
  "Ctrl_morning" = "#D1DEC8",
  "Ctrl_evening" = "#7D9970",
  "CRS_morning"  = "#E3CDB8",
  "CRS_evening"  = "#BC7A5C"
)

metadata(oxi_genebody)$anno_colors <- list(group = J_palette)

## Create heatmap object
oxi_genebody_for_heatmap <- oxi_genebody

## Remove Ensembl version numbers
rownames(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap) <-
  sub("\\..*", "", rownames(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap))

## ENSG -> gene symbol mapping
gene_labels <- rowData(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap)$gene_symbol
names(gene_labels) <- rownames(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap)

## Replace rownames with gene symbols
new_names <- gene_labels
new_names[is.na(new_names) | new_names == ""] <-
  rownames(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap)[is.na(new_names) | new_names == ""]

rownames(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap) <- make.unique(new_names)

## Sample names
colnames(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap) <-
  as.character(oxi_genebody_for_heatmap$group)

## Select all significant Morning vs Evening genes
features_trans_AMvsPM_symbols <-
  unique(
    rowData(oxi_genebody)$gene_symbol[
      rowData(oxi_genebody)$FDR_trans < 0.05
    ]
  )

features_trans_AMvsPM_symbols <-
  features_trans_AMvsPM_symbols[
    !is.na(features_trans_AMvsPM_symbols) &
      features_trans_AMvsPM_symbols != ""
  ]

## Heatmap colors
hmcols <- c("#5D7290", "#FAF7F2", "#7A6A60")

ht_opt(simple_anno_size = unit(20, "mm"))


draw(
  sechm(
    oxi_genebody_for_heatmap,
    features_trans_AMvsPM_symbols,
    show_rownames = FALSE,
    assayName = "oxoG_trans_level",
    hmcols = hmcols,
    do.scale = TRUE,
    top_annotation = "group",
    column_title = "Genebody oxoG Transcribed Strand (AM vs PM)",
    name = "oxoG level (scaled)"
  )
)

dev.off()

ht_opt(simple_anno_size = unit(5, "mm"))
```
